questions.q: The rate of metabolism of (a) / a body is comparatively lowest when (b) / it is at rest and is thus, optimum for examination. (d) / no error (e)
o: The rate of metabolism of
a body is comparatively lowest when
it is at rest and is thus, optimum for examination.
questions.s: Use "comparatively low" or "the lowest", not "comparatively lowest".

questions.q: The less you are confused while taking (a) / these tests, the less errors (b) / you will make. (c) / No error (d)
o: The less you are confused while taking
questions.s: Use "fewer errors" with countable noun.

questions.q: The food tasted deliciously / and all present in the party / enjoyed it to their full.
questions.s:
Explanation:- Use delicious in place of deliciously

kyunki 'taste' ek linking verb ki tarah se kaam kar rhi hai isliye uske baad koi adverb nahi balki adjective ka use kiya jaayega.

questions.q: Producing a different component was / as simple such launching/ a new computer program. (SSC MTS Tier-01 16/05/23)
questions.s: The correct comparative construction is "as simple as launching".

questions.q: Ramesh is smarter/ enough to get/ selected for this/ post, without any recommendations.
questions.s: Explanation:- Use smart in place of smarter. Kyunki yahan Ramesh ka kisi aur se comparison nahi karna hai isliye comparative degree use nahi hogi. Yahan meaning dena hai Ramesh enough smart hai.

questions.q: I prefer apples more than oranges.
questions.s:
With the verb prefer, we do not use “more than.”
“Prefer” itself already shows comparison.
So the correct sentence is: I prefer apples to oranges.

questions.q: Even today (1)/ it is incredulous to think (2)/ that men have walked on the moon. /(3) No error. (4)
o: it is incredulous to think
that men have walked on the moon.
questions.s: Replace “Incredulous” with “incredible”.

questions.q: Gold is / the most / precious of / all other metals.
o: Gold is
the most
precious of
all other metals
questions.s: Explanation:-   Remove other. kyunki 'superlative degree ke case me exclude krne ki need nahi hoti.

questions.q:
Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with as much interest as I was.

[MTS 26/07/2022 S3]
questions.s: "as much interest as" is correct for making comparisons of uncountable nouns like "interest."

questions.q: The photograph (a) / was comparatively better (b) / than the one that he had kept (c) / in his safe. (d)/ no error (e)
o: than the one that he had kept
questions.s: Use "comparatively good" or "better", avoid "comparatively better".

questions.q:
The people in my office are smarter than other offices.

[MTS 05/8/2019 S2]
questions.s: The sentence compares people, not offices. The correct comparison is: "smarter than the people in other offices."

questions.q: Even today (1)/ it is incredulous to think (2)/ that men have walked on the moon. /(3) No error. (4)
o: that men have walked on the moon.
questions.s: Replace “Incredulous” with “incredible”.

questions.q:
Directions: Fine out the error in each of the following sentences, if any. If there is no error, the answer is 'no error'.

It is a fact that / Mahatma Gandhi was / the first politician of his time. / No Error
o: It is a fact that
Mahatma Gandhi was
the first politician of his time.
No Error
questions.s:
‘first’ के बदले 'foremost' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Fore का Comparative former होता है किन्तु Superlative 'first' और 'foremost' दोनों ही होता है। 'first से order (क्रम) का बोध होता है;

जैसे— The first boy of the class. किन्तु 'foremost' का अर्थ होता है 'most notable';

questions.q:
Directions: Fine out the error in each of the following sentences, if any. If there is no error, the answer is 'no error'.

There were only two (a)/ soldiers but each and every (b)/ soldier was equal to five policemen. (c)/ No Error (d)
o: a
questions.s:
'Each and every के बदले 'Each' का प्रयोग होगा।

याद रखें - Each का प्रयोग 'दो या दो से अधिक के लिए' होता है किन्तु 'Every' या 'Each and every' का प्रयोग हमेशा 'दो से अधिक के लिए' होता है।

questions.q: According to the consultant (a)/ a more detail analysis of (b)/ customer needs (c)/ and product pricing is required. (d)/ No error (e)
o: a more detail analysis of
and product pricing is required.
questions.s: Use "a more detailed analysis" (adjective) instead of "more detail analysis."

questions.q: The weather / is much / more warmer / than it was a few days before.
o: more warmer
than it was a few days before.
The weather
is much
questions.s: Explanation:- (a) Warmer se pehle likha gaya 'more' hatana padega kyunki warmer already comparative degree hai iske sath more laga kar ise aur comparative banane ki zarurat nahi hi. Agar 'intensity' hi badhane ki baat hai toh uske liye 'much' already laga hua hai. Isliye yahan 'more' ko drop kar diya jayega.

questions.q: Mr. Bansal is the more methodical person in our office staff. (SSC CPO 2020 Tier-II 8 Nov 2021)
questions.s:
Methodical” is a descriptive adjective, so when comparing within a group (our office staff), we need the superlative degree.
Correct Sentence: Mr. Bansal is the most methodical person in our office staff.

questions.q: She is (a) / very much beautiful (b) / in this dress. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Much' is redundant; correct form is 'very beautiful.' Answer: (b). 'Much' extra hai, sahi form hai 'very beautiful.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: Democrats are often more receptive/and accommodating of/foreign people and cultures. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 17/03/23)
questions.s: 'Receptive' is typically followed by 'to'. For parallelism with 'receptive to', 'accommodating' should also use 'to'.

questions.q: He is (a) / the most strong (b) / man in the team. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Most strong' should be 'strongest,' the superlative form. Answer: (b). 'Most strong' galat hai, sahi superlative form hai 'strongest.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q:
He has not taken any coaching in the game but he plays good than many professional players.

[СРО 13/03/2019 S1]
o: He is playing good than
he plays the best than
he plays better than
questions.s: The comparative form of "good" is "better.”

questions.q: You must start your work without some farther delay.
questions.s:
(b) Explanation:- yhan meaning dena hai ' bina koi bhi aur delay ke' isliye ' any further delay' ka use hoga.

any - koi bhi

further - in addition to something.

questions.q:
This story is quite interesting, but I have read much interesting stories than this.

[CGL Mains- 08/08/2022]
questions.s: "Much" should be replaced with "many" because "stories" is a countable noun. The correct form is "many interesting stories."

questions.q: The man is (1)/ the most tallest (2)/ of the group (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.s: Tallest” is already a superlative degree, so adding most creates a double superlative, which is incorrect.
